description: This Java class 'IntegrationModulesLoader' is responsible for loading and parsing JSON data related to integration modules from a resource file into Java objects. It includes methods for reading JSON, deserializing data into domain models, and handling configuration details for integration modules in a Spring application context.

classes.name: IntegrationModulesLoader
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for loading, parsing, and converting JSON representations of integration modules into Java objects for use within the application.

methods.name: loadIntegrationModules
methods.description: Reads a JSON file from classpath and deserializes it into a list of IntegrationModule objects.

methods.name: loadModule
methods.description: Creates an IntegrationModule object from a map representing JSON data, including nested configurations and details.
